chunks: Certainly among the people of the Book are some who believe in God and in what has been revealed to you and what has been revealed to them; bowing in humility before God, they do not trade for a paltry gain the signs of God. Those have their reward with their Lord; indeed, God is swift in reckoning.
ai.seo_question: Who among the People of the Book are promised reward by God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to demonstrate that true faith is not exclusive to any single community, validating the spiritual status of righteous Jews and Christians who accepted their respective prophets and the final truth. The emphasis on 'khashi'in' (humble/submissive) underscores that their sincerity, rather than mere lineage, secures their reward with Allah, who is 'Sari' al-Hisab' (swift in reckoning), a concept highlighting the immediacy of divine justice in the Shia understanding of the Hereafter.
